name: 流浪鼠
habitat: 偶见于城镇 / 流浪精灵
habitatEn: Occasionally seen in towns / Wandering spirit
evolution: 奔波鼠 Lv.32 → 流浪鼠
description: 背后鼓鼓的行囊里是更多捡来的收藏品，闪闪发光的物体对它们有着无与伦比的吸引力。不论是亮晶晶的小石子，闪着微光的菌类，还是洛克不小心遗落的饰品。在劳累之后，它们也会静静地在波光粼粼的水面望着月亮。
descriptionEn: In the bulging pack on its back are more collected trinkets; shiny objects hold an unparalleled attraction for them. Whether glittering pebbles, faintly glowing fungi, or accessories a Rocco accidentally dropped. After tiring, they quietly watch the moon on the shimmering water surface.
